select MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE,'19000101'))) as MinWTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE,'19000101'))) as MaxWTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE,'19000101'))) as MinWTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE,'19000101'))) as MaxWTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE,'19000101'))) as MinWTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE,'19000101'))) as MaxWTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE,'19000101'))) as MinTAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE,'19000101'))) as MaxTAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(START_DATE,'19000101'))) as MinSTART_DATE, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(START_DATE,'19000101'))) as MaxSTART_DATE,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(END_DATE,'19000101'))) as MinEND_DATE, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(END_DATE,'19000101'))) as MaxEND_DATE,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(LCHG_TIME,'19000101'))) as MinLCHG_TIME, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(LCHG_TIME,'19000101'))) as MaxLCHG_TIME,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(RCRE_TIME,'19000101'))) as MinRCRE_TIME, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(RCRE_TIME,'19000101'))) as MaxRCRE_TIME,
MIN(convert(date,ISNULL(insert_dttm,'19000101'))) as Mininsert_dttm, MAX(convert(date,ISNULL(insert_dttm,'19000101'))) as Maxinsert_dttm
FROM d360.STG_LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN
WHERE H = 'D'
